# Draft:Empire Clash (Roblox game)

Empire Clash is an action RPG based on Roblox. In the game, 4 nations fight for a victory (domination victory), taking place in the Middle Ages to the Napoleonic era. The game was created by a team of developers from CFront Interactive.
Development and Release
Empire Clash was released on 9 May 2022 by a team of developers from CFront Interactive.
See also  The game was listed under the Empire Clash Community group on Roblox, founded by ShoomamaAtlantis. There are four factions in the game, which are the Empyrean Empire, Redcliff Republic, Overseer Commune, and the Kingdom of Korblox.
